description: Keep Renovate's PR count low and readable, for every e-llabo repository (inherited org-wide through github>e-llabo/.github): one weekly PR per repo for all non-major updates, every major update as its own PR opened at the next run, at most 5 open Renovate PRs per repo. Security fixes are not grouped, not scheduled and not counted against the PR limits (Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults). npm releases wait 3 days before they are proposed. Packages that must move together (their versions depend on each other) share one PR for every update type, majors included: see the ecosystem groups at the end of packageRules. A repository adds none of these; it only holds back a version when a real constraint of its own requires it.

packageRules.description: Every minor, patch, digest and pin update in ONE weekly PR per repository. A superset of group:allNonMajor, which covers minor and patch only. Lock file maintenance and replacements are never grouped by Renovate, so they are not listed. The weekly window is 6 hours because the Mend app runs each repository only every ~4 hours. prPriority creates this PR before any waiting major when the concurrent limit is reached.

Every major update as its OWN PR (developer decision 2026-09-25), opened at the next run rather than on the weekly schedule. Minor, patch and digest updates stay grouped (weekly here; monthly for the platform groups in default.json). Exception on purpose: packages that must move together (Renovate's monorepo and recommended groups from config:recommended, e.g. react + react-dom, or upload/download-artifact) share one major PR.

FlutterFire plugins depend on each other's major version (firebase_analytics 13 needs firebase_core 5), so every update moves them in one PR. separateMajorMinor is off because the 0.x plugins count their minors as majors and would split the group.
The Node.js runtime and its type definitions: a runtime bump without @types/node (or the reverse) fails type checking.
pnpm itself and the action that installs it must agree, or the lockfile format changes under CI.
vitest and its companion packages share one major.
ESLint, its plugins and typescript-eslint: a new ESLint major needs matching plugin majors.
The official GitHub Actions (actions/*) move to a new Node runtime together; one PR per repository instead of one per action. Third-party actions keep their own PRs.
